title: Piano lessons with a mean teacher
summary: Roy quit piano after a teacher who slapped his hands frightened him.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: And I took a little piano lessons. But what happened was that the piano player, the teacher was one of those mean cats, you know. And he'd always be slapping my hands and things like that, you know, and I didn't dig that. Plus, when you get to look like (?). This guy used to put (?) on his hair so it would stand ...(?)... And it was pretty frightening. So I didn't spend the money. I saved the money and backed out, and told my parents that I couldn't...
I wasn't making it with the teacher.
